blocks.text: После того как мистер ПинPin продемонстрировал свою способность заставить морковку левитировать, Лилия, волшебная белка, улыбнулась ему еще шире. Она осторожно взяла его лапку и, словно прошептав какое-то древнее заклинание, заставила их обоих подняться в воздух.
Мистер ПинPin был поражен. Его маленькое тело парило над землей, и ветерок шелестел его иголками. Он чувствовал себя свободным и легким, словно птица.

Рядом с Лилией в воздухе плавно парила волшебная свеча. Ее мягкий свет освещал окружающий лес, делая каждую снежинку видимой в ночной тишине. Деревья покрывались мерцающим инеем, а их ветви тяжело наклонялись под тяжестью снега.
Поднявшись выше, они подошли к входу в пещеру. С высоты весь лес выглядел как волшебное царство, полное тайн и чудес.
"Этот лес полон магии," — прошептала Лилия, подводя мистера ПинPina к входу в пещеру. — "Но только те, кто действительно верит в чудеса, могут ее увидеть и почувствовать."
Мистер ПинPin кивнул, глубоко вдыхая прохладный воздух ночи. Он понял, что этот момент изменил его жизнь навсегда.

ONE tall storyboard sheet, EXACTLY FIVE equal horizontal panels stacked vertically in ONE column, thin white gutters, target 1536x3840. No text, lettering, speech bubbles, labels, title, watermark. Flat 2D hand-drawn illustration, not 3D or photography. Clear silhouettes at phone size, simplified settings, no sepia wash, no blurry backgrounds. Stable characters across every panel, no duplicate characters, no extra limbs.
Direction C: animal-shaped woodland illustration. Historical inputs are anatomy/reference images, not edit targets. Borrow the pointed muzzle, small dark bead eyes, low oval quilled back, short clawed paws and horizontal resting/floating silhouette of the original hedgehogs. Translate their dimensional rendering into flat colored-pencil outlines and opaque gouache color planes. NOT a plush toy, not a human child, no neck, no large cartoon irises, no human fingers. Allow brief upright reaching where the story requires it, but keep the body low and animal-like otherwise. Brown-gray quills, pale gray face, black nose, one subtle slender golden spine on upper back, never a feather.
References: image85 supplies hedgehog anatomy; image87 supplies the same animal-shaped body in a magical scene. Do NOT copy berries, squirrel, snow, cave, lantern or flying into this domestic chapter.
Render all five beats of chapter3 'Home, Sweet Home', with the SAME small young PinPin on left and mother on right, mother roughly twice his size. Her anatomy is also hedgehog-like, not a tall human. Modest woodland home with blue-green round door, gray/white walls, brown table, muted red towel and quilt, orange CUT carrots, green herbs. Gradually move from evening daylight to cool blue night. No hats, cloaks, trousers or wizard props.
1. Arrival, full body: weary PinPin sits on low threshold. EXACTLY TWO tiny brown boots in entire panel: ONE boot is on his LEFT hind foot. His RIGHT hind foot is clearly BARE. Mother holds the OTHER boot away from his body and wipes it with a cloth. No third boot anywhere, no boots on forepaws. Small muddy prints behind him. Tired eyelids, relieved modest expression.
2. Supper: barefoot PinPin sits low on stool at table, holding one CUT carrot piece with little paws; mother presents bowl of cut carrot pieces and hums. No whole carrots, no boots visible.
3. Herbal bath: PinPin immersed in small wooden tub, only head, upper quilled back and forepaws above opaque water with herbs; mother attends beside him. Wholesome animal bath.
4. Drying: PinPin curled in muted red towel by small enclosed fireplace; mother carefully dries his quills with separate cloth. Bare short paws near body.
5. Bedtime: mother kisses forehead as PinPin curls low in a bed of moss and dry leaves with small muted quilt. Blue night through window. Closed sleepy eyes.
Same story and staging as other chapter3 trials; do not add events.
